text:
aisha: quick heads-up — tonight's quiet-mode rollout plan below. EU then US, canary slices 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Keep channel disciplined, use pings for urgent only.

matt: Prewarm check? any cold starts expected on edge?

linh: prewarm complete for control-plane and core-serving. two fringe nodes (edge-gpu-12, edge-gpu-15) still initializing, ETA ~4m. KV snapshots uploaded: s3://redwood-warmups/rc2-2026-03-22/kv.tar.gz

linh: Pushed image redwood/api:v3-rc2 to eu registry. Will attach canary flag feature.quiet_rollout=true

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating EU canary 1% -> redwood-api:v3-rc2 (sha: abc123def). flags: feature.quiet_rollout=true, embed.experimental=false

deploy-bot: smoke -> auth ok, gen latency 280ms, health ok. smoke log: `200 OK /health 0.28s`

sre-oncall: Baselines: p99 < 360ms, error_rate < 0.6%. Alert thresholds set to error_rate >= 0.6% for 4m, p99 +60ms for 5m. Runbook: https://intra/release/playbooks/quiet-mode.md :clipboard:

matt: Good — can we bump EU traces to 20s sampling for next 45m? Need more detail on cold path.

sre-oncall: Done. Trace sampling increased. Also enabled extra log verbosity for worker auth module for canary.

product-nina: Release notes live: https://docs.internal/releases/v3-rc2.md. Callout under "behavior changes": tokenization tweaks + opt-out instructions. Support on standby.

linh: Note: embeddings endpoint will be disabled until 25% slice. config toggle set: embeddings.enabled=false in EU canary.

aisha: Keep embeddings disabled until explicit go. If 25% holds for 20m, we flip and monitor for memory/regressions.

matt: If a rollback is needed target commit is abc999 (last green). Rollback shorthand: `deploybot rollback --to abc999 --reason "canary regress"`. Notify #customer-impact and #postmortems on any rollback.

linh: For local repro or quick checks:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://smoke-eu.internal.redwood/health
```

sre-oncall: If we detect memory growth > 10% in 10m or error_rate spike > 0.6% for 4m we'll enter rollback lane A. I'll open incident channel and promote to page if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary 1% steady for 7m, moving to 5% in 3m unless blocked.

matt: Can we pin this rollout window in deploy-bot so no other automations touch it?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout pinned by aisha until 1768005899. Autopatcher disabled for affected services.

product-nina: Heads-up: customer-facing changelog has migration note and links to opt-out npm package. Support doc: https://docs.internal/support/rc2-hotfix.md

aisha: Great. Keep replies concise. If anything anomalous, tag @sre-oncall or @aisha and drop :rotating_light:. We'll hold final 100% expansion behind a 30m stable window after 25% completes.

sre-oncall: Monitoring now. I'll stream p99/latency dashboards and tail auth logs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled US canary 5% at 1768005490 (approx 58s). EU -> US handoff planned after EU 25% green.

aisha: thanks team — silence unless blocking.

matt: ACK.
